slides.texte_overlay:
how to love someone
with ADHD
(the small things that matter most)

1. don't take the forgetting
personally.

they forgot the thing,
not you

2. remind them without the sigh.

a soft "hey, did you…"
lands so much better
than "you ALWAYS forget"

3. let them info-dump.

when they talk for 20 minutes
about one painting, one war,
one random fact, they're letting you
into their favourite place

4. don't call it lazy.

the hard part for them
is usually starting,
not caring

5. sit with them while they do
the thing they've been avoiding.

you don't have to help.
just being there
makes it easier to begin

6. plan the fun stuff together,
but leave room for
last-minute ideas.

spontaneity is part of them

7. when they go quiet
after a long day,
it's not about you.

their brain is just
out of battery

8. tell them what they do right.

most people with ADHD
have heard "why can't you just…"
their whole life

save this for someone
who loves an ADHD brain
